name: Ritual Effects

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-14: Twice in Steel

disable: This hazard persists until Hesla's ritual is complete and her demonic forces defeated.
routine: (two actions) The ground shakes, and waves of demonic energy surge through the cavern. Each PC must make a save against tremors and a save against demonic energy. Enemy combatants must only make the Reflex save against tremors; they are immune to the Demonic Energy effects.

items.name: The Ritual Continues
items.text:
Trigger Combat begins within Deskari's Gullet

---
Effect The Ritual Effects roll initiative. Each combat indicates how often this hazard triggers during that combat.

items.name: Tremors
items.text: Targets take 1d8+4 bludgeoning damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save save) as rocks fall from the ceiling. On a critical failure, the target falls Prone.

items.name: Demonic Energy
items.text: Targets take 1d8+4 void damage (DC 23 basic Fortitude save save). On a critical failure, the target is Sickened 1. Holy creatures treat their save as one degree worse for the purposes of the sickened condition only.

text: The effects of Hesla's profane ritual ripple outward through Deskari's Gullet. Physical tremors shake the cavern complex, while magical waves of energy affect those opposed to her actions.
